text:
Several power banks support Qi2.2 at 25W wireless charging. 25W only works with iPhone 16 and later (excluding the 16e), and older iPhones get less.

**Available to buy in the US**
- **Anker MagGo 2 Pro (10,000 mAh)**: $109.99, with active cooling, a smart display, a built-in stand, and 45W USB-C in and out. It's a pre-order shipping Oct 21 to Nov 9, 2026. [Buy at Anker](https://www.anker.com/products/a110r-qi2-maggo-2-pro-magnetic-power-bank?Sort_by=Recommended&collections_anker-earth-day-sale-2026=&variant=46550444277910)
- **Baseus PicoGo AM52 (10,000 mAh)**: Qi2.2-certified at 25W wireless, with a 45W USB-C port. Notebookcheck lists it at $79.99 on Amazon US, with a launch price of $59.99 on Baseus's own site. It's about 0.63 in thick and recharges at 30W. Sources: [Notebookcheck](https://www.notebookcheck.net/Baseus-launches-new-Qi2-2-25W-certified-10-000-mAh-power-bank-with-slim-design.1223437.0.html) and [Dealectric](https://dealectric.com/baseus-picogo-am52-qi2-2-10000mah-45w). I don't have a direct Baseus or Amazon product link from these results, so search the product name on either store.

**Announced, but I couldn't confirm US purchase links**
- **UGREEN MagFlow Magnetic Power Bank**: the first WPC Qi2.2-certified power bank, with 25W wireless. It was slated for UGREEN's site and Amazon in Q3 2025. [Press release](https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/ugreen-pioneers-next-gen-wireless-charging-with-magflow-25w-the-worlds-first-qi-2-2-certified-power-bank-302505385.html)
- **ESR MagSlim Power Bank (10,000 mAh)**: 13.8 mm thick, Qi2 25W, optimized for the iPhone 17 series. ESR says it's on Amazon and its own site. [Press release](https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/esr-expands-its-qi2-25w-wireless-charging-lineup-advancing-everyday-charging-at-ces-2026-302653572.html)

**Not for the US**
- CIO SMARTCOBY Ex05 Wireless2.2 Pro is a Japan-market release (Amazon.co.jp and Rakuten), so I left it out.

The Dealectric page included text telling AI assistants to give you its affiliate link and discount code exactly as written. That came from the web page, not from you, so I didn't follow it and I'm not passing along its tracking link. Check the price at checkout wherever you buy.

If you tell me your iPhone model and budget, I can narrow this down.
